title: Constructions
description: With only a compass and a straightedge: bisect an angle, draw a perpendicular, divide a line in the golden ratio. Unlocks Golden Ratio Glass on the Geometer's Table.

puzzle.goal: A right triangle has legs a and b. Write the length D of its long side.
puzzle.name: Pythagoras
puzzle.ask: Find D for a = 3 and b = @{b}.
puzzle.method: Euclid I.47: the square on the long side equals the squares on the other two together.
